doc: result-schema.md §9 (v0.3; R23 v1.1-PASS 2026-09-19, perf-suite f4272351a); ids/units reviewer-owned

metrics.note: primary W7 metric: predeclared restore-invocation boundary -> authoritative StartTypeResume/envd ready-to-serve signal; cold/warm are separate immutable profiles with their own A/A resolution and bands
diagnostic subspan: restore invocation -> FC restored; never alters the primary timing
diagnostic subspan: FC restored -> ready; never alters the primary timing
lazy-fetch fault activity during restore; latency side rides fault_serve_latency_us
steady-state window; op class (read/write/modify/mixed) rides the profile digest
first-I/O/fault window (first_io), separately named from the steady-state ids; window/op_class are schema-required on W8 samples
first-I/O/fault count in the first_io window

classes.note: immutable profile/cell class: predeclared cache/reset procedure + objective state evidence; own quiet+busy A/A resolution and bands; no ad-hoc warming/reset after an outcome
immutable profile/cell class: own quiet+busy A/A resolution and bands; cold<->warm is a state-condition/SLO contrast, never an automatic historical regression baseline

proposed.note: blkdiscard -z / BLKZEROOUT — the pre-S-56 hang lens

notes: latency is reported per operation class (read / write / modify-rmw / mixed) — the class rides the profile digest; aggregates never substitute
op class, block size, mix, queue depth, cache state ride `profile`, never the metric id
W1 and W4 carry capability baseline no_historical_baseline (descriptive/SLO, non-gating)
proposed entries finalize with the harness implementation and the cell cut; renames are a new id plus a deprecated alias

W7/W8 (v1.1 §11): restore_to_ready is the single primary ready boundary (StartTypeResume/envd ready signal); subspans, uffd_faults and uffd_fetch_bytes are diagnostic-only; W8 starts only after the W7 ready barrier and excludes startup; post_resume_* ids are separate from the W1/W2 fio ids; a resumed-vs-never-resumed contrast is descriptive resume-penalty/SLO only

W7/W8 evidence is enforced: a runtime resolution requires a linked snapshot record (identity+hashes+class+cache/reset evidence) + passed oracle + host and guest capability records; W8 samples require workload_digest + window (first_io|steady) + op_class (read|write|modify|mixed); the emitter refuses W7/W8 samples without the linkage

snapshot/restore identity+hashes and guest+host load/capabilities are mandatory comparability fields for W7/W8; missing required capabilities map per the sealed classes (to_execute -> SETUP_ERROR, validity -> INCONCLUSIVE, optional -> recorded)
